ios.desc:
Savvy: Daily Microlearning App

Build your Real World IQ, a few minutes at a time

Book smart is easy to test for. Real world smart only shows up in the moment, when there's no time to think it through, and it's the one kind of smart school never taught you. Savvy builds it a little every day, one short lesson at a time.

Each scenario takes seconds to play: a first date going quiet, a boss dodging your raise ask, a friend crossing a line, a decision you're not sure about. You pick how you'd respond. Savvy shows you what works, what backfires, and why, plus how everyone else answered. No courses to finish, no lectures to sit through, just daily microlearning that compounds into instinct. Every scenario sharpens your Real World IQ.

How It Works

- You get dropped into a real moment and choose your move. 
- Savvy breaks down the smart play, the common mistake, and the reasoning behind it, all in under a minute, so you walk away sharper than you started.

Why People Use Savvy

- Quick lessons, not long courses
- Get instant feedback on every choice
- See how everyone else answered
- Fits into a coffee break or a commute
- Build sharper instincts through practice, not reading

What Raises Your Real World IQ

- Reading people and situations
- First dates & dating app conversations
- Salary negotiations & tough work conversations
- Setting boundaries & saying no
- Money and decision-making calls
- Handling conflict, criticism, and awkward silences
- Speaking up in groups and meetings

Who It's For

Savvy is for anyone who's ever gone blank mid-conversation, made a call they regretted, or replayed a moment wishing they'd handled it differently. Textbook smart doesn't always show up when it counts. Savvy is where you build the version of smart that does, a little every day.

Why It Works

Real world IQ isn't something you're born with, and it doesn't come from reading about it either. It's built the same way any instinct is built: short, specific, daily practice. Savvy turns real situations into quick lessons so the smart response stops being an afterthought and starts being automatic.

Try Savvy free for 7 days. Start getting smarter, one scenario at a time.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I stopped doomscrolling (built an IOS app for it)

quotes.text:
I had this bad habit of picking up my phone without thinking. Mornings, breaks, late at night. Open Insta or Twitter “for a min” and boom, 30–40 mins gone. Not even fun scrolling. Just autopilot.

Tried app blockers. Tried turning off notifications. Didnt last. Blocking just made me annoyed, and I’d end up disabling it.

So I built Mindsnack.

Instead of blocking apps, it lets you binge small concepts around life skills. If something actually interests you, you can go deeper and take short lessons. The idea is to replace empty scrolling with something that at least feels intentional.

Tech stack is pretty simple:

- React Native
- Node backend
- Postgres
- A backend agent that generates short courses

Didnt build this to be more productive. Built it because I was tired of losing time without choosing it.

I still scroll sometimes. I’m planning to make it more interactive and engaging over time.

Curious to hear from others:

- have you used any app to stop doomscrolling?
- what worked or didnt?
- would replacing the habit work better than blocking?

Happy to hear honest thoughts, even if this sounds dumb
